name: Mary McIntyre
biography: A doctor and apothecary who made a terrible mistake on a patient, and was cursed fittingly by a powerful witch the late patient knew: any living thing withers at her touch. Mary has exhausted all options for lifting the curse, and left with the choice between total ruin and an adventure with a slim chance of success, she chose the latter. Surely anyone powerful enough to make the Tower would have some means to break curses…

specialtyClass.name: Death-Cursed Apothecary
specialtyClass.description: A specialist in support and healing—from a distance. Provides beneficial potions and such to allies with varying effects, or equally varied harmful things for enemies. At melee range, can lethally poison with her touch.
